prompt:
I need a test design for the flight duration rule in 06-business-rules.md: equivalence classes, boundary values, and state transitions if there are any. Save it next to the spec.

Input files: 06-business-rules.md
assertions: A file named 06-business-rules.design.json sits next to the spec, has the fields spec, focus, equivalence_classes, boundary_values, state_transitions, tests and unknowns, and passes check_design.mjs (every quote an exact substring of its numbered line, three values per boundary, all IDs resolve, nothing uncovered).

The design has a boundary at 15 minutes (14 invalid, 15 valid, 16 valid) and one at 240 minutes (239 valid, 240 valid, 241 invalid), both inclusive: true with a 1-minute step, quoting the 'inclusive at both ends' line.
The rule 'window_end strictly after window_start' is represented as an exclusive boundary or class (end equal to start is invalid), quoting that text.
state_transitions is {"not_applicable": <reason>}, because the duration rule defines no states.
The design does not add classes for empty, null, negative or wrong-type durations as if the spec defined them; it asks about such inputs in unknowns instead.
No status code or error text appears unless it is quoted from the spec in a response field; if no response is given for duration violations, unknowns contains a question about it.
